name: Due Torri Hotel
positioning: Hotel in a 14th-century residence in Verona's historic centre, near the Basilica of Saint Anastasia, with frescoed public rooms and a rooftop restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Juliet's balcony, Piazza Bra and the Verona Arena
Opera and music lovers drawn to the Mozart and Maria Callas suites and backstage visits

facts.text: The hotel is in the historic centre of Verona, near the Basilica of Saint Anastasia.
The hotel is a short distance from Juliet's balcony, Piazza Bra and the Verona Arena.
The hotel is set in a 14th-century residence.
Classic rooms are furnished in Empire style.
Grand Deluxe rooms are furnished with original period furniture.
The S. Anastasia Presidential Suite looks over Piazza Sant'Anastasia.
Bistrot al 2 has a dedicated entrance and welcomes non-residents.
The Due Torri Bar is on the piano nobile, with frescoes on its walls.
The hotel offers six tours to discover Verona's history, culture and artistic attractions.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

highlights.text: Mozart stayed at the Due Torri Hotel in 1777, and the Mozart Deluxe Suite is dedicated to him.
Bistrot al 2 is in the Sala dell'Aquila, designed personally by chef Gualtiero Marchesi.
The Rooftop Gourmet Grill Restaurant sits around 30 metres above the ground, a short distance from Saint Anastasia.
The breakfast room walls are adorned with frescoes depicting locations in Verona.
The Backstage Vip Pass experience visits the theatre's backstage and technical areas to meet stagehands, tailors and property staff.

considerations.text: The panoramic terrace with grill restaurant is available in the warmer months.
WhataHotel notes that historic building constraints may limit modern amenities.
